key.name: language-area-enabled
key.description: Keep the language (input source) indicator in its own area, always at the left of the tray icons

key.name: tray-icon-spacing
key.description: Space each tray icon keeps on its left and right side in pixel, 0 packs the icons together without any space

key.name: tray-pos
key.description: Set where the Icon tray should appear in Gnome tray

key.name: tray-order
key.description: Set where the Icon tray should appear among other trays

key.name: max-visible-icons
key.description: How many tray icons are shown at once, the ones beyond that number are folded behind the button in the panel

key.name: icon-order
key.description: Order the tray icons are shown in, as indicator ids

key.name: custom-icons
key.description: Replace any icons with custom icons from themes
